source: eWAVE (The Electronic World Atlas of Varieties of English)
citation: Kortmann, Bernd & Lunkenheimer, Kerstin & Ehret, Katharina (eds.) 2020. The Electronic World Atlas of Varieties of English. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology. Available online at https://ewave-atlas.org/

license_verification.method: git clone of https://github.com/cldf-datasets/ewave (real clone, not a fetch of a cached page), then LICENSE file, README.md, metadata.json and .zenodo.json all read directly from the cloned repository.
sources_checked: cldf/../LICENSE in the cloned repo -- the full, verbatim Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported legal code
README.md -- 'This dataset is licensed under a CC-BY-3.0 license'
license_verification.result: CC BY 3.0, confirmed identically across all four independent statements in the repository itself. No ambiguity or conflict found. Fully open -- staged generously per this repo's shared staging rules.

fetch_method: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/cldf-datasets/ewave.git (real git clone of the canonical CLDF dataset repository named in the pocket description).
coverage: The complete current eWAVE CLDF dataset is staged in full in cldf/ -- all 77 rated varieties (languages.csv), all 235 morphosyntactic features (parameters.csv), the complete 18,095-cell variety-by-feature rating matrix (values.csv, 77 x 235), every rating code definition (codes.csv), all 4,200 recorded illustrative example sentences (examples.csv), the full contributor list (80+ names, contributors.csv), and the atlas's own introductory essays -- because the whole structured release is small (about 1.1MB of CSV/text, not gigabytes) and is itself the natural bounded, single-session-fetchable unit; filtering the raw tables to a subset of varieties would have discarded the cross-variety comparison that is the actual point of an atlas. On top of that complete raw dataset, this pocket additionally renders 29 curated, readable prose documents in varieties/ -- one per variety eWAVE itself types as an English-based Pidgin (7) or English-based Creole (19), plus the 3 High-contact L1 varieties explicitly named for African American Vernacular English (Urban/Rural/Earlier AAVE) -- per this batch's pidgin/creole/AAVE theme. Those 29 rendered documents are a curated subset (29 of 77 varieties get a dedicated prose document); the other 48 varieties' data is present in the raw cldf/ tables but was not additionally rendered into its own document. Not staged: map.svg (1.7MB image, out of scope for a text-priors repo), ewave-1.0.zip (legacy bundle, redundant with the canonical cldf/ tables already staged in full), and WAVEquestionnaire.pdf (the contributor questionnaire form -- methodological/procedural content, not corpus data).

structure.cldf/: Complete CLDF core release, copied verbatim from the cloned repository: languages.csv (77 varieties incl. Type_ID P/Cr/L1c/L1t/L2, region, Glottocode, ISO 639-3, and the atlas's own prose description of each variety), parameters.csv (235 features), codes.csv (the six-point A/B/C/D/X/? rating scale, defined per feature), values.csv (18,095 ratings), examples.csv (4,200 illustrative example sentences), contributors.csv (80+ chapter contributors), featurecategories.csv (the 12 feature categories), varietytypes.csv (the 5 variety-type definitions: L1t, L1c, L2, P, Cr), regions.csv (8 macro-regions), history.csv (version history), media.csv, sources.bib (bibliography), introduction.md and home.md (the atlas's own descriptive essays), LICENSE, README.md.
structure.feature-catalog.txt: All 235 features rendered as readable prose, grouped by the atlas's 12 categories, each with its name, illustrative gloss (where given), source citation, and cross-variety attestation/pervasiveness statistics. 9,117 words.
structure.varieties/: 29 rendered per-variety documents (all 19 Creoles + all 7 Pidgins + the 3 AAVE-named High-contact L1 varieties): metadata, the atlas's own prose description, every recorded example sentence for that variety, and the full 235-feature rating profile with per-category breakdown. 2,103-4,539 words each; all clear this repo's 600-word floor without padding.

not_staged.reason: out_of_scope -- a 1.7MB SVG world map image; this repo holds text priors, not cartographic media.

already_included -- a legacy bundled archive of an older release format; the current canonical CLDF tables (values.csv, languages.csv, parameters.csv, etc.) are already staged in full in cldf/, so re-staging the older zip would only duplicate the same content in a stale format.
out_of_scope -- the blank contributor questionnaire form used to collect the ratings; methodological/procedural document, not corpus content.

not_staged.item: The remaining 48 of 77 varieties (traditional L1, indigenized L2, and non-AAVE high-contact L1 varieties, e.g. Scottish English, Indian English, Singapore English)
not_staged.reason: already_included -- not a gap: their full metadata, descriptions, 235-feature ratings, and example sentences are all present in the raw cldf/ tables staged in full. They were not additionally rendered into their own curated prose document because this pocket's own instructions specifically prioritize the pidgin/creole/AAVE theme for the curated per-variety renderings; the full data for all 77 is real and staged, just not duplicated into a second prose format for the 48 outside this batch's theme.
